parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/FlowsheetConverterTests.swift. The two methods — parsesTimestampWithFractionalSeconds (line 198) and parsesTimestampWithoutFractionalSeconds (line 223) — are distinct test cases that exercise different timestamp parsing code paths (with and without fractional seconds). Even though their structural similarity is high (Jaccard 0.8), the divergence is intentional: each test encodes a separate, named behavioral contract. Merging or extracting them would obscure which specific input variant is under test and reduce the diagnostic value of individual test failures.
